title: Flo's Bowser in the Sky on the ares emulator (US), where AutoSplit64++ 0.6.0 split the Grand Star 2 minutes early
labels: Only the game, cut from 1975 s of a 1080p OBS recording of the whole run, compressed to fit in the repository. Its log from 0.6.0, on the same clock as the video to within half a second: fadeouts entering the fight at 13 s and 170 s, a death at 159 s, the split at 225.7 s while Bowser was alive, his defeat speech at 352 s, the Grand Star from 353.5 s, and Mario grabbing it at 361.867 s, the first frame without it. Mario is hurt, so the power meter shows, partly inside the area the Grand Star is looked for in. The runner's timer stopped at the early split, so there are no splits of theirs.
